purpose: Reviewed public source locations returned by AreaData country and regional work for reuse as Census Dashboard Kit discovery starting points.
status_boundary: A feedback record is reusable discovery context only. It is never current-project proof of acquisition, content inspection, geography matching or indicator adoption.

records.title: Government notice on commune-status decree
records.publisher: Service d’information du Gouvernement du Burkina Faso
records.reuse_note: Government notice describes a 2026 commune-status decree but does not supply a verified 2019-to-current unit crosswalk. Locate the decree and official unit list before joining current authorities to census communes.

records.title: Fichier des localités du 5e RGPH (2019)
records.publisher: Institut national de la statistique et de la démographie (INSD)
records.reuse_note: Official 2019 locality population by sex and age, including source-noted estimates for security-affected places. Use the 2019 13-region/45-province/351-commune geography; do not relabel it as the 2025 17-region/47-province system. Recheck raw redistribution terms.

records.title: Guide méthodologique de planification locale: PCD (December 2024)
records.publisher: Ministère de l’Économie et des Finances
records.reuse_note: December 2024 communal development-plan (PCD) guide predates the 2025 territorial code and administrative reform. Check the guide's current applicability and the chosen locality's legal planning authority; no local plan is implied.

records.title: Guide méthodologique de planification locale: PRD (December 2024)
records.publisher: Ministère de l’Économie et des Finances
records.reuse_note: December 2024 regional development-plan (PRD) guide predates the 2025 territorial code and administrative reform. Do not equate a 2019 statistical region with a current planning body without legal crosswalk.

records.title: Government notice on 30 July 2026 territorial competence-transfer decrees
records.publisher: Service d’information du Gouvernement du Burkina Faso
records.reuse_note: New AreaData location: 30 July 2026 official council notice reports competence and resource transfer decrees under law 024-2025/ALT. Signed decree texts, numbers, commencement and selected-area application are not acquired; this is not a plan or budget.

records.title: Loi n°024-2025/ALT portant Code général des collectivités territoriales
records.publisher: Assemblée législative de transition / Académie de Police du Burkina Faso
records.reuse_note: Law no. 024-2025/ALT cover and parliamentary adoption were checked. The 114-page posted PDF is scanned; its article-level requirements and present applicability were not text-verified. Verify exact articles and current consolidated status before prescribing a planning index.

records.title: MATM / CONAFIL local-finance publications
records.publisher: Conseil national de la statistique / Ministère de l’Administration territoriale et de la Mobilité
records.reuse_note: Official MATM/CONAFIL catalogue lists local-government budget forecasts and transferred-resource execution reports. Inspect each report body and local identifiers; a forecast is not an approved area budget or actual execution.

records.title: Komsilga communal development-plan procurement notice
records.publisher: Direction générale du contrôle des marchés publics et des engagements financiers
records.reuse_note: Official 2025 procurement notice for preparing Komsilga's PCD. This is a lead to the planning process, not a completed or approved plan, local budget or implementation result. Verify current commune identity.

records.title: Rapport national 2024 sur les plans locaux de développement
records.publisher: Ministère de l’Économie et des Finances, DGDT
records.reuse_note: National 2024 monitoring report on local development plans, published in 2025. It is a planning-system reference, not evidence that any selected commune's plan or budget was obtained or approved. Check any area-specific document separately.

records.title: Disparités communales de la pratique contraceptive au Burkina Faso
records.publisher: Institut national de la statistique et de la démographie (INSD)
reference_periods: 2015 outcome model, 2019 census covariates; August 2023 report
records.reuse_note: This is a modelled 2015 outcome using 2019 census covariates, not 2019 contraceptive prevalence. Three ambiguous commune name matches were withheld; review the crosswalk and raw reuse terms.

records.title: RGPH 2019 Volume 3: Mesure et cartographie de la pauvreté
records.publisher: Institut national de la statistique et de la démographie (INSD)
reference_periods: 2018 household survey with 2019 census frame; Annexes 5-9 use RGPH 2019
records.reuse_note: Volume 3 Annex 4 monetary-poverty values are small-area estimates combining EHCVM 2018 with 2019 census geography, not directly enumerated census poverty. Annexes 5-9 report distinct census measures. Two whole-city commune aggregates and four incomplete rows were withheld; recheck definitions, geography, and redistribution terms.

records.title: Résultats du 5e RGPH: volume des tableaux statistiques
records.publisher: Institut national de la statistique et de la démographie (INSD)
records.reuse_note: Official statistical-table volume has 581 identified table headings; 17 have selected adopted values, 11 have reviewed decisions without new adoption, and 553 await semantic review. Table II.10 fertility values conflict with the final report's prose and figure (AreaData evidence: burkina-faso-fertility-source-conflict-2026-09-25.md); do not adopt or reconcile them automatically. Inspect numeric columns, denominators and source versions; regional rates are not commune rates.
